groups.text: Ticket 5 examined the seams of toy.analyze: how it refuses a run, where its goal check points, and how it words the comparison to paper-a. Its guards exit 2 for a missing cell, after a `cells:` line on stdout, exit 3 for a summary at non-default features, epochs, lr, batch_size or rows, and exit 4 for held_out_labels that differ from the regenerated split or between arms, in every case with no JSON or report written, so an experiment ticket can read the code to tell why a run refused. {res:t5-a1/src/toy/analyze.py#AnalysisError} Real summaries must record rows 20000 or pass --expect-rows. {res:t5-a1/src/toy/analyze.py#AnalysisError} The per-signal JSON's goal_artifact path is always <results>/signal-4/raw_x3x4/seed-1/summary.json whatever signal is analyzed, with auroc and reaches null until that file exists, so the E2 sweep JSONs for signals 1, 2 and 8 cite the E1 artifact. {res:t5-a1/src/toy/analyze.py#_goal_check} The report's 'several points' sentence expresses the mean paired gain in points, one point being 0.01 AUROC, with no floor and no verdict, since paper-a gives no number. {res:t5-a1/src/toy/analyze.py#render_report}

E1 fitted four arms at signal 4.0, raw, raw + x3*x4, the wrong-pair control raw + x1*x2, and raw + all six pairwise products, on ten seeds each, and scored every cell on its own seed's 4000-row held-out split. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/e1-checks.json#non_default} C1 is supported at this headline signal: the paired gain, the held-out AUROC of raw + x3*x4 minus raw on the same draw, has mean 0.0864 over ten seeds with a 95% bootstrap interval of [0.0829, 0.0897] from 10000 resamples, holds = true, and 10 of 10 seeds positive. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#paired_gain} Every seed's DeLong interval for that difference lies above 0, the lowest per-seed difference being 0.0770 at seed 3 and the highest 0.0941 at seed 10. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#paired_gain} This signal-4 verdict is also the signal-4 term of C3, which E2's conjunction uses. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#paired_gain} C2 is supported at signal 4.0: the credit margin, raw + x3*x4 minus the wrong-pair control raw + x1*x2 on the same draw with the same number of columns, has mean 0.0862 with 95% bootstrap interval [0.0827, 0.0897], credited = true, and 10 of 10 per-seed values positive, the smallest being 0.0774 at seed 2. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#credit_margin} Every per-seed DeLong interval for (raw_x3x4, raw_x1x2) also lies above 0, and this is also the signal-4 verdict for C4. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#credit_margin} A4 is reported without a verdict: the all-pairs cost, raw + all six pairwise products minus raw + x3*x4, has mean -0.00023 with 95% bootstrap interval [-0.00080, 0.00032], which includes 0. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#allpairs_cost} Per-seed DeLong intervals for that difference include 0 on 9 of 10 seeds; seed 5's is [-0.0036, -0.0003] with diff -0.0019. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#allpairs_cost} An interval that includes 0 says the six-product arm finds the pair on its own at this signal, so the model need not be told which pair matters. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#allpairs_cost} Descriptively, raw + all six pairwise products minus raw has mean 0.0862 with 95% bootstrap interval [0.0823, 0.0898]. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#allpairs_vs_raw} Set against paper-a's 'several points' (A5), the mean paired gain of 0.0864 AUROC at signal 4.0 is about 8.6 points, comfortably in the range that phrase describes at this one signal, though it says nothing yet about 'every signal strength tried', which is E2's question. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#paired_gain.mean} The Bayes ceiling, the oracle ranking's held-out AUROC, ranges 0.8489 to 0.8637 per seed at signal 4.0 (mean 0.8571), and the ceiling minus raw_x3x4 is positive on all ten seeds, from 0.00004 at seed 5 to 0.0023 at seed 4, with mean 0.00089. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#ceiling} The raw + x3*x4 arm therefore sits within a quarter point of the ceiling on every seed. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#ceiling} The reproduction check of the --features refactor (Q14) passes bitwise: on device cuda for both runs, the flagless seed-1 run's auroc is 0.8502984862625299 and the explicit raw_x3x4 seed-1 cell's is 0.8502984862625299, a difference of 0.0, with bitwise = true and within_1e-6 = true. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/e1-checks.json#reproduction} The goal check (Q2), which is reported only and is neither a stopping rule nor evidence for any claim, finds the goal artifact results/ablation/signal-4/raw_x3x4/seed-1/summary.json at auroc 0.8502984862625299, GOAL.json's eval_command (PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m toy.eval --split held_out) printing the same value, and reaches_target (>= 0.82) = true; the seeds at or above 0.82 per arm at signal 4.0 are raw 0, raw_x3x4 10, raw_x1x2 0, raw_allpairs 10. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/e1-checks.json#goal_artifact} Held-out discipline (Q5) holds: there are 10 summaries for each of raw, raw_x3x4, raw_x1x2 and raw_allpairs, 40 in all, non_default is empty, every cell records its arm's features, epochs 30, lr 0.1, rows 20000, batch_size 256, signal 4.0, its seed, and 4000 held-out scores and labels, and toy.analyze's label-regeneration guard passed. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/e1-checks.json#non_default} GPU time (Q11) was 160.5 s for the forty signal-4 cells plus 4.0 s for the flagless run, 164.5 s in total against the 14400 s cap. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/e1-checks.json#gpu_seconds}

E2 extends the same four-arm, ten-seed design to signals 1, 2, 4 and 8, which gives 10 summaries per arm at each signal and 160 in all. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-1.json#cells} C3 is supported: the paired gain holds at all four signals, with mean and 95% bootstrap interval 0.0305 [0.0259, 0.0355] at signal 1, 0.0562 [0.0519, 0.0600] at signal 2, 0.0864 [0.0829, 0.0897] at signal 4, and 0.1113 [0.1073, 0.1152] at signal 8, and at every signal all 10 seeds have a positive gain. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/report.md#Omnibus} {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-1.json#paired_gain} {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-2.json#paired_gain} {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-8.json#paired_gain} The omnibus result is true as the conjunction of four per-signal verdicts, none corrected for multiple comparisons (Q12); it is a per-signal test with intervals, standing in for paper-a's 'every signal strength tried'. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/report.md#Omnibus} C4 is credited at every signal: the credit margin has mean and 95% bootstrap interval 0.0299 [0.0243, 0.0349] at signal 1, 0.0553 [0.0512, 0.0588] at signal 2, 0.0862 [0.0827, 0.0897] at signal 4, and 0.1117 [0.1080, 0.1155] at signal 8. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-1.json#credit_margin} {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-2.json#credit_margin} {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#credit_margin} {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-8.json#credit_margin} Because the gain holds at all four signals, C4 is supported at every signal where it applies and no signal is moot. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-8.json#credit_margin} A3 is confirmed: the seeds at or above 0.82 per arm (raw / raw_x3x4 / raw_x1x2 / raw_allpairs) are 0/0/0/0 at signal 1, 0/0/0/0 at signal 2, 0/10/0/10 at signal 4, and 10/10/10/10 at signal 8. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-8.json#goal_check.seeds_at_or_above_target} The raw arm clears 0.82 on all 10 seeds at signal 8, while the raw_x3x4 arm clears it on 0 of 10 seeds at signals 1 and 2, where the gain holds; the goal check is reported only and is not evidence for any claim. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-8.json#goal_check.seeds_at_or_above_target} For A5, the mean paired gain in points (one point = 0.01 AUROC) is 3.1 at signal 1, 5.6 at signal 2, 8.6 at signal 4, and 11.1 at signal 8, set against paper-a's 'several points' with no floor given and no verdict drawn. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/report.md#Omnibus} A4 and A6 are descriptive, with no verdict. The all-pairs cost (raw_allpairs minus raw_x3x4) has mean and 95% interval -0.0021 [-0.0051, 0.0008] at signal 1, -0.0015 [-0.0030, -0.00001] at signal 2, the only interval just below 0, -0.0002 [-0.0008, 0.0003] at signal 4, and -0.0002 [-0.0004, 0.00003] at signal 8. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-2.json#allpairs_cost} The wrong-pair control minus raw has an interval that includes 0 at all four signals, and all-pairs minus raw has an interval above 0 at all four and tracks the paired gain. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-2.json#allpairs_cost} The budget (Q11) came to 641.0 GPU seconds over the four signals (160.2 at signal 1, 160.1 at signal 2, 160.5 at signal 4, 160.2 at signal 8) against the 14400 cap, or 645.0 with the flagless run's 4.0 s, which lies outside the spec's sum. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-1.json#gpu_seconds} Held-out discipline (Q5) holds across the sweep: toy.analyze accepted every one of the 160 summaries at the Q5 settings, nothing was re-fitted, and no goal artifact was exported. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-1.json#cells}

structured_output.negative_results: On ticket 5, the worker prompt omitted the ticket's ## Notes and quality criterion, which is where the guards, the JSON shape and the test list (a)-(g) live, and attempt 1 failed for that reason; reading research/tickets/05-*.md directly is what fixed it. {res:t5-a1/research/tickets/05-toy-analyze-per-signal-analysis-json-metric-prin.md#notes} A1 was not triggered at signal 4.0: the paired gain holds and the credit margin's 95% interval [0.0827, 0.0897] excludes 0, so the wrong-pair control does not keep pace and the gain is credited to the right interaction rather than to extra capacity. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#credit_margin.ci95} A6 at signal 4.0, reported with no verdict, shows wrong_pair_vs_raw (raw + x1*x2 minus raw) with mean 0.00015 and 95% bootstrap interval [-0.00068, 0.00111], which includes 0, so the product column the label does not use shows no capacity gain over raw here. {res:t36-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-4.json#wrong_pair_vs_raw} A2 was not confirmed: no signal fails, so the sweep has no failing signal to explain as saturation or noise. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-8.json#ceiling.means} The raw_x3x4 arm sits near the Bayes ceiling at every signal, with ceiling minus raw_x3x4 (ceiling in brackets) of 0.0028 (0.622) at signal 1, 0.0015 (0.732) at signal 2, 0.0009 (0.857) at signal 4, and 0.0003 (0.947) at signal 8. {res:t37-a1/analysis/ablation/signal-8.json#ceiling.means}
